purpose: Fail-closed decision register for the exact nineteen Batch C core-care and RMIK requirements. Matrix dispositions and local teaching behavior are candidates only; this register claims no authoritative evidence, appointment, approval, equivalence or parity acceptance.

evidence.note: Authoritatively reviewed clinical-pathway reference evidence is pending.

normal.description: Publish a versioned synthetic pathway reference and associate it with an eligible synthetic encounter without auto-authoring clinical facts.
expected_results: Only the effective pathway version is offered for the approved encounter context.
Selection is attributable and leaves clinical documentation, RMIK completeness and quality measures reconcilable.

denial.description: Attempt wrong-role publication and use of a retired pathway version.
expected_results: Unauthorized or retired-version actions are denied without changing the encounter.
No pathway association or downstream measure is partially created.

correction_or_amendment.description: Correct an erroneous synthetic pathway association after recording an explicit reason.
expected_results: The prior association, reason, actor and time remain immutable.
The corrected association and downstream measures reconcile exactly once.

dependency_outage.description: Make the documentation or quality-measure dependency unavailable during pathway association and retry after recovery.
expected_results: The operation fails closed without a partial association or derived measure.
Retry is idempotent, attributable and produces one reconciled result.

accountable_owner.required_scope: Approve pathway lifecycle, eligibility, clinical-use boundary, correction and RMIK/quality consequences.

appointment_dependencies.required_scope: Canonical disposition and bounded synthetic scope.
Pathway content, version, eligibility and clinical-use rules.
Publication authorization, audit and data boundary.
